pixel_hint: clean game sprite, crisp dark outline, keep the flat magenta background flat

ranger.idle: idle breathing in a ready stance, cloak sways a little
ranger.attack: draws the glowing bow and shoots an arrow to the right, then lowers the bow
ranger.hurt: takes a hit: the whole body jolts backward to the left, the head snaps back, then stands ready again. Plain body motion only, no magic, no glow trail, no particles, no effects
ranger.defeat: falls back and sits down on the ground, dizzy
ranger.skyshot: raises the bow to aim high up at the sky, draws the string back, shoots an arrow straight up, then lowers the bow. Plain body motion only: no magic, no glow trail, no swirl, no particles, no effects.
